skillNamesFr.source: https://github.com/build-wars/gw-skilldata (json/skilldesc-fr.json — French NAMES only; no French descriptions are shipped)
skillNamesFr.freshness: Its OWN key because availability is independent of the skills pipeline: only the Pages and clone channels serve French (npm 2.0.0 exports English and German only), so an npm-fallback run refreshes skills.json and leaves this table untouched. A sourceVersion older than the skills entry means the last import ran without a French channel, not that anything failed. Both entries currently name the same upstream commit. This record still carries ONE hash where the skills entry carries five, because the table was regenerated on its own after the data import that added 31 skills merged: the French code and the new data landed in two separate PRs, so the importer never ran with both at once. The next full import rewrites this in the standard form.
